title: Bryce Cotton's points in each game against Melbourne since 2015-16
sql: select strftime(r.match_time_utc, '%Y-%m-%d') as label, b.points as value from box_player b join results r on r.match_id = b.match_id where b.first_name = 'Bryce' and b.family_name = 'Cotton' and b.opp_name = 'Melbourne United' order by r.match_time_utc, b.match_id

title: Every 30-point game since 2015-16: minutes played and points
sql: select first_name || ' ' || family_name || ', ' || points || ' pts in ' || minutes as label, (cast(split_part(minutes, ':', 1) as int) * 60 + cast(split_part(minutes, ':', 2) as int)) / 60.0 as x, points as y from box_player where points >= 30 and minutes is not null and season >= '2015-2016' order by x, label

title: Where Adelaide's 97 points came from
sql: select label, value from (select 1 as ord, 'Threes' as label, three_pointers_made * 3 as value from box_team where match_id='36dbeb55-58ad-11f1-a69b-43a6b5595d3e' and name='Adelaide 36ers' union all select 2, 'Twos', two_pointers_made * 2 from box_team where match_id='36dbeb55-58ad-11f1-a69b-43a6b5595d3e' and name='Adelaide 36ers' union all select 3, 'Free throws', free_throws_made from box_team where match_id='36dbeb55-58ad-11f1-a69b-43a6b5595d3e' and name='Adelaide 36ers') order by ord
